quote: HIDE never_reported (figure folded into a residual line no 10-K/10-Q splits) - FY2018 10-K R8 CF operating changes (May 31, 2018 | May 31, 2017 | May 31, 2016): only trade receivables, prepaid expenses and other assets, accounts payable and other liabilities, income taxes payable and deferred revenues are printed; "Increase in prepaid expenses and other assets | (276) | (24) | (2)". Combination proof: FY2017 10-K 0001193125-17-214833 R8 prints "(Increase) decrease in inventories | (88) | 88 | (96)" and "Decrease (increase) in prepaid expenses and other assets | 64 | (90) | (387)"; the FY2018 10-K 0001193125-18-201034 R8 re-presents FY2017 and FY2016 with no inventories line and "Increase in prepaid expenses and other assets | (276) | (24) | (2)", where (24) = 64 + (88) and (2) = (90) + 88: from FY2018 the inventory change sits inside the prepaid/other line. Full-text search (efts) of ORCL 10-K/10-Q for "increase in inventories" finds only 10-Ks to FY2016 and 10-Qs to the Feb-2018 quarter (9-month YTD, no annual FY2018 figure); no 10-K for FY2018-FY2026 prints an inventories line.
rule_proposal: The residual line '(Increase) decrease in prepaid expenses and other assets' does not name inventories, so it is not a combined line under the 2026-11-22 standard; no 10-K or 10-Q prints an annual inventory change for this year (efts search quoted). Stays hidden.
